node.statement: One Newton correction. Let S:B->B(H) be dagger-preserving with ||S||_cb<=2 and multiplicative defect G(x,y)=S(xy)-S(x)S(y) of cb bilinear norm b. Use the diagonal of node 1.2.1 and put w'(x)=sum_s S(p_s U_s^dagger)G(U_s,x), w''(x)=w'(x^dagger)^dagger, w=(w'+w'')/2, and S^+=S+w. Then ||w||_cb<=2b and S^+ is dagger-preserving. Exact associativity of B and B(H) gives the exact cocycle identity S(x)G(y,z)-G(xy,z)+G(x,yz)-G(x,y)S(z)=0. Expanding the coboundary S(x)w(y)-w(xy)+w(x)S(y), using XD=DX and multiplication(D)=I, cancels G; every uncancelled term contains two factors each bounded by b (one may be the replacement S(x)S(y)-S(xy)). Consequently a direct triangle estimate gives ||G_{S^+}||_cb<=K_N b^2 for one numerical universal K_N, while ||S^+-S||_cb<=2b. The same identities hold at every amplification by node 1.2.1, with K_N independent of n, dim B and dim H.
